text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm going to win! Me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Nobody else! ME!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(Her energy... Her fire! It's like it's
blazing up from
deep, deep within...)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...But I won't let her win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Pant, huff... Wheeze...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...I couldn't do it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: (And the problem is...)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man, talk about a nail-biter! What a
great race!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Right?! ...Especially that girl who crashed
the interview.
Did you see how she ran?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Damn! That was so lame!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: B-but... But!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: RRRAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It'd be even lamer if I let this break my
spirit! I
can't give up! I won't lose again! I
won't! Next
time, I'm gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You all just watch! This is the beginning
of my
legend!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka dashes into the runners' tunnel.
There are
so many spectators watching
her that you'd think
she was the only
Umamusume in the whole
racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...
To be honest, I wasn't really
expecting much from
her.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: But now? I can't wait for her next race!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: I hear that.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Wow. Even though she lost?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Ughhh!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Like I'm going to let her outdo me!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: We're changing strategies.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: For the next race. I was thinking that the Tulip Sho would be the best race to help get me ready for the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But Vodka just made a huge splash, and
I'm
pretty certain the waves reached
Scarlet as well.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: A rising tide lifts all boats.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This wave may even return... to lift
Vodka herself.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, who do you think would win in a
race?
Vodka or Scarlet?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'm talking about the Tulip Sho.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
They haven't said yet. Vodka is having
trouble
choosing between the Classic
Triple Crown tour
and the Triple Tiara
tour.
choice_data_list: ……2人とも出走すると言ってたのか？
……2人とも出走すると言ってたの？
choice_data_list_en: ...Did both of them say they were running?
...Did both of them say they were running?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tulip Sho is generally seen as a race
for
Umamusume who plan to run in the
Oka Sho
afterwards.
choice_data_list: じゃあ、『チューリップ賞』に出るとは――
choice_data_list_en: Then, entering the Tulip Sho means—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Right, but I'll see to it that she enters. If
both of
them run, it'll be explosive. Like
fireworks.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fireworks I can't set off alone. Fireworks
so
striking and dramatic that everyone
will look up
and watch.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And then, just when the time is ripe, I'll
take the
stage—a stage set for the
biggest and most
glorious production.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In other words, we should make my next
race the
Fillies' Revue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm having more trouble than usual
following her
logic... but she seems to
have made up her mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For better or worse, Aston Machan isn't
one to
take other people's opinions into
account.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the Fillies' Revue would be a
good
preliminary for the Oka Sho. It's
not a bad choice
at all.
choice_data_list: （仮に反対しても聞かないだろう）
choice_data_list_en: (She probably wouldn't listen even if I objected.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's decided—our next race is the Fillies'
Revue. I
just hope that someday Aston
Machan will let me
know what's going on
in her head.
